text: Volume is not where my objection sits: day_vol 0.74 is minervini's and wyckoff's point, and writing it into the trigger is theirs to settle. Mine is set-up type (R1): h1_close_above:bar_high with dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.45 is a close at a new high, no higher low to buy, and I have no range series for a contraction call (bar_range_history NOT_SERVED, R5). Holding the OBJECT; ABSTAIN is not a veto. Clears if a dip into ma_20 holds and hooks, or WATCH until it prints.
